title: Selected Topics in Germanic Studies; Montage and Modern Life
description: Jointly offered with GERM689G. Credit only granted for GERM449G or GERM6 89G. This seminar explores the relationship between montage/collage arti stic practice and various conceptions of political art and literature in 20thcentury Germany. Authors, artists, and filmmakers to be discussed include Adorno, Benjamin, Brecht, Heartfield, Hoch, Kluge, Ruttmann , Seghers, Vertov, and Weiss.
